def transform(grid):
    # Find a solid separator column; the two equal-sized panels flank it.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))), None)
    if sep is None:
        raise ValueError('no solid separator')
    left_w, right_w = sep, w-sep-1
    n = min(left_w, right_w)
    # Output records occupied (non-background) cells from either panel.
    # The panel backgrounds are each their most common colors.
    from collections import Counter
    lb = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row[:n]).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rb = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row[sep+1:sep+1+n]).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[2 if (grid[r][c] != lb or grid[r][sep+1+c] != rb) else 3 for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
PY

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A one-column divider splits the grid into equal-width panels.
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)))
    left_w = sep
    right_w = w - sep - 1
    n = min(left_w, right_w)
    left = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
    right = [[grid[r][sep + 1 + c] for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
    shared = set(v for row in left for v in row) & set(v for row in right for v in row)
    # Common palette color is the unmarked output color; matching cells are highlighted.
    bg = next(iter(shared)) if shared else 0
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == right[r][c] else bg for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
